# AO coverage — whole subject

*Generated by build/make_work_order.py. Regenerate, never edit.*

The syllabus states its assessment-objective weights as a share of **marks**, across the whole examination. That is a property of the subject, not of any one topic: a topic about what enterprise means is naturally definitional, and a topic about choosing a source of finance is naturally evaluative. Forcing each topic to the same split would distort the teaching to satisfy an average. What has to match is the total below.

✅ **largest gap 4 points** across 2,099 marks-equivalent of practice.

A gap inside 5 points is the plan matching the exam. A larger one means the item plan needs more of that kind of practice - not that a topic should be padded.
